::: {.callout-important title="This is a four-chapter pilot, not the complete workbook"}
This document contains **only Chapters 1 through 4** of *Modern LLM
Architecture: A Visual Guide to Attention, Memory, Sparsity, and Hybrid
Models* (workbook 04 of the ML/LLM Study Workbooks series). Chapters
5-8 -- mixture-of-experts models, case studies, architecture -> systems
consequences, and a synthesis/practice chapter -- are planned but
**not drafted**. Nothing in this document should be read as implying
those chapters exist yet. Multi-head latent attention (MLA), briefly
deferred out of Chapter 3's drafting pass, is now covered in Chapter 4
alongside sliding-window and sparse attention, as three distinct
attention-cost-reduction strategies (see `outline.yaml`'s `ch4.drafting_note`).
Chapter 4 covers recurrent/state-space/linear-attention alternatives
only as a brief taxonomy and forward reference, not their mechanics,
pending adequate primary sourcing.

This is a review artifact: it exists to establish the workbook's
explanatory depth, visual language, page density, question style, and
citation style before the remaining chapters are drafted at scale.
Treat any rough edge you find as exactly the kind of thing this pilot
is meant to surface early.
:::
